basic_details.job_title: WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Electrical Engineer, Instrumentation and Control Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: WAPCOS Limited is engaging Experts on a project-term basis for posts: Electrical Engineer, Instrumentation and Control Engineer, Senior Labour Specialist, Full-Time Resident Expert / Residential Expert and Commissioning Engineer. The posts are for Project Management Consultancy (PMC) work on the 120 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Power Project at Rokhia, near Agartala. Candidates apply online on the WAPCOS portal (www.wapcos.co.in), then email the application PDF, a completed CV and supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 10 November 2026.

qualification.details: All five posts have the same pay rule: remuneration is set at the time of engagement, based on the candidate's qualifications, professional experience and the needs of the project. All five posts have a maximum age limit of 67 years. A Master's degree in the relevant field will be an advantage. Degrees listed on the job page: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.), Master of Engineering (M.E.) or Master of Technology (M.Tech.) in Electrical Engineering. Experience: At least 10 years of general experience in the power sector. Experience in developing gas-fired combined-cycle or thermal power plant projects with a capacity of 100 MW or more in a single unit will be an advantage. Maximum age: 67 years. | Essential qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. A Master's degree in the relevant field will be an advantage. Degrees listed on the job page: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Electrical Engineering, or a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Experience: At least 10 years of general experience in the power sector. Experience in developing a gas-fired combined-cycle or thermal power plant project with a capacity of 100 MW or more is desirable. Maximum age: 67 years. | Essential qualification: Master's degree in Labour Law, Social Science, or a related field. Degrees listed on the job page: Master's degree in Social Science; Master's degree in Labour Law. Experience: At least 20 years of professional experience. This must include relevant experience in labour management, with 5–10 years spent preparing labour management plans for large construction projects and supervising how contractors' supply chains carry them out at construction sites. Essential knowledge: An understanding of national labour laws and international good practice, including ILO guidelines. Preferable: Experience with international multilateral organizations. Maximum age: 67 years. | Essential qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering. Degrees listed on the job page: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Electrical Engineering. Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience providing consultancy services in project development, project planning and project management in the power sector. Advantage: Experience in planning, managing or operating thermal power generation projects, and the ability to communicate in the local Bengali language. Maximum age: 67 years. | Essential qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering. A Master's degree in the relevant field will be an advantage. Degrees listed on the job page: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Experience: At least 10 years of experience in power-sector infrastructure projects. Experience in consulting services for developing a gas-fired combined-cycle or thermal power plant project with a capacity of 100 MW or more is preferred. Maximum age: 67 years. | The experience counted is post-qualification experience as on 01.10.2026. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Upload these documents as self-attested PDF or JPEG scans when you apply online: Maximum file size: 2 MB per document. Photograph: JPG / JPEG, less than 100 KB. Signature: JPG / JPEG, less than 50 KB. The email to [email protected] must carry the application PDF, your completed CV and your supporting documents. If the name, surname or spelling differs between your application and your certificates, submit a certificate from the SDM or an equivalent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The WAPCOS Expert posts are filled by shortlisting. Applications that meet every eligibility criterion (qualification, experience, age, category and documents) will be shortlisted. Relevant experience will be given due weightage. The Management reserves the right to set criteria that restrict the number of candidates, if it finds this suitable. Shortlisted candidates will be informed only through their registered e-mail or the WAPCOS website. No individual communication will be sent by post. Shortlisting does not guarantee selection or a right to a job. Offer and deployment letters will be issued strictly on the basis of project requirements. WAPCOS's decision on all matters of selection and deployment will be final and binding. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate immediately.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Electrical Engineer, Instrumentation and Control Engineer, Senior Labour Specialist, Full-Time Resident Expert / Residential Expert and Commissioning Engineer. WAPCOS says the number of positions may change with project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 10 November 2026. The application PDF, CV and supporting documents must also be emailed to [email protected] on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the WAPCOS Expert posts?
faq.answer: It depends on the post. The engineering posts need a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or (for Commissioning Engineer) in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, as each post specifies. The Senior Labour Specialist needs a Master's degree in Labour Law, Social Science, or a related field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all five Expert posts is 67 years. Age is counted as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is required for the WAPCOS posts?
faq.answer: Electrical Engineer, Instrumentation and Control Engineer and Commissioning Engineer each need at least 10 years of experience, the Senior Labour Specialist needs at least 20 years, and the Full-Time Resident Expert / Residential Expert needs at least 5 years. Experience is counted as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for WAPCOS Expert posts?
faq.answer: WAPCOS will set the remuneration at the time of engagement, based on the candidate's qualifications, professional experience and the project's requirements.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register and submit the online application on the WAPCOS portal (www.wapcos.co.in → Careers → Advertisement → Apply Online), then choose Print application / Save PDF. Email that PDF, your completed CV and your supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the WAPCOS Expert posts?
faq.answer: Applications that meet all eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category and documents) will be shortlisted, and relevant experience will be given due weightage. Shortlisted candidates will be told only by registered e-mail or on the WAPCOS website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the WAPCOS Expert job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary, initially for 11 months, and can be extended depending on project requirements and satisfactory performance. It is co-terminus with the project and gives no right to regularization, permanency or absorption into WAPCOS.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need an NOC for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in Government, a PSU or an Autonomous Body must obtain a valid NOC from their current employer before joining. They also upload that NOC with the online application.
